message.content:
Based on the visual analysis of the provided dashboard image, here is the list of all visual problems:

**Problem** | **Element** | **Severity**
--- | --- | ---
Vertical Text Overflow | Top-left navigation area (text "topics, competitors...") | **Critical**
Text Overlap / Clipping | "Crisis Score" section (baseline text overlaps with "0 alerts") | **High**
Broken Layout / Misalignment | Top row metrics (values like -0.52 and 100 appear disconnected from headers) | **Medium**
Content Spilling / Clipping | Geographic Intelligence map (City labels like "Casablanca" overlap with data bubbles) | **Medium**
Awkward Spacing | Crisis Score panel (Large gap between score "2" and description text) | **Low**
Misaligned Elements | Alert Velocity/Sentiment rows (Scores "0/100" are right-aligned but descriptions are left-aligned creating unevenness) | **Low**
Potential Watermark Bleeding | Background of the map area (Faint grid lines or watermark visible behind map elements) | **Low**
